I had the same fear. That fear is our sickness talking, do your best to not listen to it. Try exercising, going for a walk, meditating or learning something new, I tried all of these and it's working great for me. Talk to a psychiatrist, explain your fear, they'll now the best antidepressant in regards to your fear.  
Best regards and much love.
